name: Ayakashigami
source:
A visual novel based on Japanese Mythology.

Shinboku-chan is an androgyne, having the reproductive organs of both sexes. Entrusted with the task of surveying a group of mysterious youkai, he ends up sharing a moderately eventful summer alongside the girls. It is a friendship-filled adventure with a dash of horror and a little something something.

[From [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/565690/discussions/0/154644045353027913/?tscn=1482246529#c154644045364427613]Steam forum[/url]]
translation:
以日本神话为背景的视觉小说。

Shinboku-chan是雌雄同体，拥有两性的生殖器官。他接受了调查一群神秘妖怪的任务，最终与女孩们一起度过了一个颇为多事的夏天。这是一次充满友谊的冒险，还夹杂着一丝恐怖和一些东西。
